system.description:
The curse preserving you can pass into those shattered by your embalmed fists.

When you inflict a critical injury with your Slam, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against Mummy Rot. The disease level is equal to your level. Stage 1: carrier with no visible effect for 1 minute. Stage 2: 4d6 essence damage and Injured 1 for 1 day. Damage inflicted by Mummy Rot cannot be healed until the curse is removed and the disease is cured. A creature can be exposed to your Mummy Rot only once per day.

Spread by Mummy Rot (Unliving Mummy) at the mummy's level. Stage 1 lasts 1 minute; stage 2's interval is a day, as its Injured is. Damage it inflicts cannot be healed until the curse is removed and the disease cured — the table's.
